text:
maya: Quick callout 1: we need a final v1 decision for Private networking: preserve customer IPs through upgrades or preserve only control-plane (BGP) and rotate data-plane. Field leaning?

jordan: From infra1: control-plane-only is less risky for GA. preserves BGP, keeps upgrade automation.

sylvia: Field: customers ask for "no surprise" topology. Full IP preservation is ideal but many customers will accept control-plane-only if it's documented.

alejandro: Engineering: full IP-preserve requires agent skip-teardown and MAC pinning; prototype ~1w, harden ~2w. Fallback proxy is doable but needs bandwidth OK from customers.

devx: DX: add `redwoodctl network preflight` and a maintenance checklist. For preview customers, label feature "ip-stable-preview" and include SRE onboarding doc.

maya: Proposal: default=control-plane-only GA; opt-in ip-stable-preview for high-touch customers with SRE. Launch gates: (1) tests + installer flag; (2) two pilots; (3) docs + rollback runbook. Agree?

jordan: Agree. I'll author the upgrade-playbook and test matrix.

sylvia: Field agrees. We'll nominate pilot customers and sanitise checklists.

alejandro: I'll deliver a prototype skip-teardown branch and a lightweight relay PoC in 5 days.

maya: Action items noted. We'll reconvene in 48h to lock pilot names. :spiral_calendar:
